open_points.subject: Run / EffectAttempt lifecycle (M19, M26)
open_points.text: K-08: "only the owner's resolution moves it: applied, or not applied." + Primary action: "cancel a run ... the run ends `cancelled`; nothing further is sent."
open_points.question: If a run is `pending` on `outcome_unknown`, may the owner cancel it without first resolving that unknown attempt, and if so does the unknown attempt remain unresolved forever?
options: Cancellation is refused while any `outcome_unknown` waiting point exists
Cancellation is allowed; run ends `cancelled`; unknown attempts stay `unknown`
Cancellation is allowed and implicitly forces a resolution (applied or not_applied)
open_points.default_guess: Cancellation is allowed; run ends `cancelled`; existing unknown attempts remain `unknown`.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant effect on already-waiting approvals (M25, M19/M20)
open_points.text: Primary action: "grant a standing approval ... the node ... stops asking"; M25 defines grant scope by flow version but does not state behavior for waits already at `owner_approval`.
open_points.question: When a grant is created for a node, does it immediately unblock existing runs already waiting for owner approval at that node, or only affect future effect sends?
options: Applies immediately to current waiting points on runs pinned to that flow version
Applies only to future attempts created after grant time
Applies only to runs started after grant time
open_points.default_guess: Applies immediately to current and future attempts on runs pinned to that flow version.

open_points.subject: EffectApproval cardinality per waiting effect (M24)
open_points.text: M24 defines `approval_id` and statuses but no uniqueness rule such as "at most one `requested` approval per run/node/map/attempt/request".
open_points.question: Can multiple simultaneous `requested` approvals exist for the same run node/map element (same effect decision point), and if yes how are they intended to be decided/used?
options: At most one open `requested` approval per decision point
Multiple `requested` approvals allowed; owner decides by `approval_id`; any one may become used
Multiple allowed but older ones are auto-obsoleted when a new one is requested
open_points.default_guess: At most one open `requested` approval per decision point.

open_points.subject: Stale requested approvals when request changes (M24)
open_points.text: M24 states: "neither the end of a run nor a changed request changes a status" and explains stale `approved` approvals, but does not say what happens to a still-`requested` approval after request change.
open_points.question: If the built request changes before the owner decides a `requested` approval, should that pending approval remain decidable, be auto-refused, or be auto-obsoleted?
options: Remain `requested` and decidable until run end
Auto-obsolete/close it when request digest changes
Auto-refuse it when request digest changes
open_points.default_guess: Remain `requested` and decidable; if later approved and stale, it is simply unusable authority.
